text: Alla ko Kanko wurni on nokku ka O woodini on ɓaawo hari on laatike waasaaɓe, refti O wara on si ngurnandam mo'on ɗan lannii, refti O wurnita on kadi ɓaawo maayugol mo'on fii yo O hasbu on e dow golle mo'on, O yoɓa on e ɗum. Pellet, neɗɗanke on ko o heewuɗo yeddirgol neemaaji Alla ɗin -fii kala hiɗi feeñi- sabu rewugol makko wonndude e Alla tanaa Makko.
